topology_note: SW1 is a Cisco 2960 with VLAN 20 (Accounting, 10.10.20.0/24) and VLAN 30 (Marketing, 10.10.30.0/24). File server is on Fa0/20 in VLAN 20. PC3 is on Fa0/5.
expected_fault: Port Fa0/5 is assigned to VLAN 30 (Marketing) instead of VLAN 20 (Accounting), so PC3 is in the wrong broadcast domain and cannot reach VLAN 20 resources.
source_evidence:
SW1# show vlan brief

VLAN Name                             Status    Ports
---- -------------------------------- --------- -------------------------------
1    default                          active    Fa0/22, Fa0/23, Fa0/24
20   Accounting                       active    Fa0/1, Fa0/2, Fa0/3, Fa0/4,
                                                Fa0/20
30   Marketing                        active    Fa0/5, Fa0/6, Fa0/7, Fa0/8
99   Management                       active
1002 fddi-default                     act/unsup
1003 token-ring-default               act/unsup

SW1# show interfaces Fa0/5 switchport
